author: Dana Example
headline: Research Scientist | Machine-learning interatomic potentials
text: New preprint: we fine-tune a universal MACE foundation model on 4,000 DFT frames of molten LiCl-KCl with low-rank adapters. The adapted model reproduces the experimental structure factor and cuts the error on Cl-Cl pair distributions by 40% versus the base model, at 1% of the cost of training from scratch. Code and data released.

author: Lee Placeholder
headline: Computational Scientist, national laboratory
text: Our SC paper shows how we scaled equivariant graph neural network potentials to 10,000 GPUs on an exascale machine. Key trick: overlapping neighbor-list construction with message passing, which gave 3.1x throughput on 100-million-atom systems.

author: Jordan Mock
headline: PhD student, tribology and 2D materials
text: Paper accepted: reactive MD with a machine-learning potential reveals how oxygen substitution in MoS2 raises friction at low temperature. We validate against cryogenic tribometer data from 150 K to 300 K.

author: Open Materials Lab
text: We are releasing an open dataset of 50 million DFT calculations on electrochemical interfaces, with a benchmark for universal interatomic potentials on solvated electrode surfaces.
